sources.publisher: CNPq (with CAPES and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs), Public Call 16/2026
sources.note: Full call text: only academic (stricto sensu) programmes; professional programmes excluded; institutions choose their strategic research themes and the programmes that receive scholarships
Call page: attachments are the call text, Annex I (a spreadsheet form that institutions fill in) and Annex II (an institutional representative letter); no results or programme list published

subject_rule: The call names no list of fields: it supports only academic (stricto sensu) master's and doctoral programmes recognised by the education authorities, and says no scholarships are granted for professional master's and doctoral courses; each institution sets its own strategic research themes and the programmes that receive scholarships, so the fields depend on the institution chosen.
notes: No programmes recorded: the call text does not list programmes or fields, and at the check date no list of the institutions chosen by CNPq (a preliminary result was due in November 2026) was found on the official pages that could be read.
Annex I of the call is a blank spreadsheet model for institutions; it is not a list of programmes.
Institutions are not obliged to name the programmes that will receive scholarships when they apply, but must state the areas and strategic research themes they will support.
not_stated: A list of fields, programmes or majors
The institutions selected under the 2027 call
fetch_problems: No published result of Call 16/2026 (institutions selected, with their programmes) was found on the CNPq pages read, so no per-institution programme list exists yet in the sources.
